q: Crude oil is a thick black liquid found together with natural gas in the Earth.
e: Crude oil is indeed a thick black liquid that is often found alongside natural gas.

q: Today, about 40 % of the world's energy comes from natural gas.
e: Today, about 40 % of the world's energy comes from petroleum, while 20 % comes from natural gas.

q: The crude oil and natural gas were formed from dead animals and plants that lived in the seas a long time ago.
e: Crude oil and natural gas are formed from the remains of dead marine organisms.

q: High pressure and temperature changed the dead materials into coal over millions of years.
e: High pressure and temperature changed the dead materials into petroleum, not coal.

q: Crude oil and natural gas are hydrocarbons made up of hydrogen and carbon only.
e: Hydrocarbons are indeed compounds made up solely of hydrogen and carbon.

q: Natural gas consists mainly of propane and butane.
e: Natural gas consists mainly of methane, not propane and butane.
